messages:
zoe: noticed a small but steady rise in 409s from a handful of tenants since we flipped the default handshake last night. Mostly clients still sending x-client-version: v1. Curious if we should soften the response to reduce retry storms.
carl: can you share an example request/response?
zoe: yep, pattern is:
```
req: POST /v1/generate  x-client-version: v1
res: 409 { \"error\": \"version-mismatch\", \"served\": \"v2\" }
```
jess: clients that treat non-2xx as transient will just keep hammering. We saw similar when we migrated headers last year.
mira: operationally, I'd prefer a quarantine bucket that marks the request with `x-compat-quarantine: 1` and returns a 409 + but we also emit a metric per-tenant. Then console can surface a yellow tape.
zoe: idea: two-stage quarantine. Stage A (strict): 409 + metric tagging. Stage B (soft): after we detect retry-looping (metric threshold) for that tenant/route, return 200 with a shim payload + `x-deprecation-warning` header so clients stop retrying.
carl: returning 200 for incompatible payloads feels risky. What's the shim payload look like?
jess: it would be a very explicit compatibility wrapper, e.g.:
```
200 {"compat_rendering":true, "warning":"using v1; results may vary; migrate to v2: docs.redwood/migrate"}
```
mira: important: billing semantics must be unchanged. Soft-mode should be billed normally but flagged in logs and partner reports. Also add `compat.soft_mode=true` telemetry tag.
infra-bot: deploy/notice: handshake-default-change rolled to prod-a at 02:17 UTC. Canary success 99.9%.
zoe: low-friction console affordance: for affected tenants show a banner: "Compatibility mode active on this route. Use simulate->v2 to preview results." Offer a 'simulate v2' toggle that proxies a sample request to v2 and shows diff. Must log simulate usage in audit events.
carl: +1 for simulate. Also suggest a per-tenant autopilot rule: if `compat.quarantine.retry_rate` > 1.0 req/s for 3m -> flip tenant to soft-mode; send automated email with remediation steps.
jess: add a metric `compat.quarantine.error_rate` and a short-lived counter `compat.quarantine.retry_count_window` so ops can detect exponential retry growth.
mira: agreed. Also add a console action to 'force-strict' for tenants that want to stay strict for compliance reasons. Must require SSO confirmation.
zoe: UX copy draft for banner: "This route is receiving requests from an older client (v1). Compatibility mode applied to reduce retries. Learn how to migrate: docs.redwood/migrate-v1-to-v2"
carl: ops runbook sketch: 1) watch `compat.quarantine.retry_rate`, 2) if spike -> enable soft-mode, 3) if soft-mode doesn't reduce retries in 20m -> open P1 and revert default. Provide commands for emergency toggle in console: `console.toggle_compat_mode(tenant, mode)`
jess: add note in runbook: do not change quota/billing when toggling modes. Only affect response semantics and telemetry.
mira: outreach plan: create list of tenants with >100 requests in last 24h from v1. Send targeted migration guide + offer a migration call.
zoe: next steps: 1) infra: emit `compat.quarantine` tags + metrics (carl) 2) console: add banner, simulate toggle, force-strict button + audit (ux + jess) 3) ops: implement autopilot thresholds and runbook (mira) 4) growth: outreach list and template (zoe)
carl: i'll open infra ticket with example metric lines and a simple fallback header (`x-version-suggest: v2`).
jess: i'll prototype the simulate flow and audit events.
mira: i'll draft runbook and tenant list.
zoe: check back in 90 minutes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
